Graduate Degree Programs
NIU offers many master’s, specialist, and doctoral degrees, as well as graduate certificate programs to prepare you to take the next step in your career. More than 80 graduate degree programs across six colleges. Graduate certificates in over 65 courses of study. And one bright future. Explore our graduate programs to see how we can shape your tomorrow.
Please visit the College of Law for information on Juris Doctor (J.D.) programs.
